newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-DISCIPLINARY SITUATION IN EUROPEAN COMPETITIONS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DISCIPLINARY SITUATION IN EUROPEAN COMPETITIONS.

text.p: The following list shows players with yellow and red cards going into this week's European club competition semi-final first legs:

Yellow cards: Julio Cesar, Wolfgang Feiersinger, Heiko Herrlich, Andreas Moeller, Martin Kree, Paolo Sousa
